scope: Six sourced publication cards, four underlying developments; two additional issuer copies are deduplication inputs. No private personal details or full articles.

articles.title: Nvidia responds to reported intelligence allegations
articles.summary: ABC reports allegations involving Nvidia leadership and a company spokesperson response disputing their implications. The report attributes the claims to prior reporting; they are not established findings.

articles.title: Statement from NVIDIA Board of Directors
articles.summary: NVIDIA board opens an independent investigation following reported foreign intelligence targeting of its CEO. The board says it has no reason to believe national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised and expresses confidence in leadership. Allegations remain under investigation.

articles.title: Statement From the Independent Members of the NVIDIA Board
articles.summary: NVIDIA independent directors retain outside counsel to conduct the previously announced independent investigation. This is an investigation update, not a finding of wrongdoing.

articles.title: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition
articles.summary: NVIDIA board announces its CEO has resigned, effective immediately, and appoints its CFO interim CEO. This later leadership change is separate from the earlier unresolved security allegations.
